purpose: Operational fitter qualification after the K2R3 post-freeze mechanism diagnostic established that the frozen naked raw-prior fitter cohort contained zero F4-attainable objects under both production and R0/R1/R2 reference fitting. Reuse the resolved K2R3 capacity evidence, run the already-approved response-blind production-matched common burn-in first, define the fitter cohort only by the preregistered F4 mathematical hard gate plus chronology, adjudicate continuous-fit regret on that operational F4 cohort, and only after those gates pass continue the frozen V2, evaluator-fidelity, lower-order and calibration-only causal chain.

parent_k2r3.runtime_input_rule: read the authoritative completed K2R3 run in place through its marker; no K2R3 audit archive or post-freeze diagnostic JSON is a runtime input

operational_burnin.scientific_semantics: byte-semantic reuse of the P13-S0-K2R2 common_burnin protocol for the 8192-proposal production-matched generic GP calibration run
operational_burnin.operational_fitter_membership_rule: chronologically first up to 128 unique structural skeletons whose unchanged production fit emits at least one F4 branch; membership uses only the preregistered F4 mathematical hard gate plus chronology; no J threshold, score rank, top-k, response, characteristic, capacity resemblance, or historical outcome
operational_burnin.V2_parent_membership_rule: chronologically first 64 members of the same operational F4 stream

operational_fitter.reference_optimizer: exact byte-semantic reuse of P13-S0-K2R2 reference_optimizer_v2 and R0/R1/R2 cohort-wide ladder
operational_fitter.claim_boundary: continuous-fit quality conditional on operational F4 attainment; the separate burn-in gate adjudicates whether the current search+production-fitter system forms enough F4 state within 8192 proposals

continuation.residual_graft_protocol: byte-semantic reuse of p13_s0_k2r2_protocol.json residual_graft section
continuation.evaluator_fidelity_protocol: reuse original K2 gate through K2R2 implementation
